purpose: AR client, invoice pages: a service for /api/v1/ar-invoices and /api/v1/ar-invoiced-shipments whose commands send Idempotency-Key equal to body.eventId; an invoice list with URL-restored filters; an invoice detail that shows the server totalAmount rather than a line sum, line amounts without rounding and sales-unit quantities and, with fulfillment.view, links from lines to their shipments, with confirm, cancel and void through the existing useCommandEvent (an uncertain outcome retries the same eventId); and a create-from-shipments page that lists SHIPPED shipments, marks those already invoiced, limits the selection to one customer and 20 shipments, and locks the form while an outcome is uncertain. menu.js gains the accountsReceivable group these pages declare.
data: No database or network: mocked services and real discovered pages, with inline objects of at most 4 shipments, 2 invoice lines and 1 invoice. No fixture files.
concurrency: Within a case: 1, no concurrent requests. Runner workers unchanged: the existing client job keeps Vitest's default file workers.
thresholds: All 23 new cases pass. The client coverage configuration is unchanged (it sets no numeric floor); server floors are untouched. No timing threshold.
trigger: Existing ci.yml triggers and discovery only, in the existing client test job: admitted PR dispatch, push to main and the existing weekly schedule. No new job, step, schedule or dispatch. No capacity or performance workload.
cost: Local run of the 3 new files: 23 cases in about 0.3 s of test time (about 1.1 s wall). Not measured in CI. No new job. Browser evidence is a private Playwright run outside CI discovery (3 flows, mocked AR API because the AR endpoints of #372/#375 are not in main), kept in .worktrees/ci-pm-handoffs/ar-client-invoices-browser-20261120; it adds nothing to CI.
